name: El Cerro de Andévalo (Spain)
description: White field with narrow red and blue stripes along the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Cerro de Andévalo (a tower and a tree on blue).
history: Municipal flag of El Cerro de Andévalo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
